content: मण्डलिन् {%a.%} [मण्डल-इनि] .²1 Forming a circle, made up into a coil; वाता मण्डलिनस्तीव्रा व्यपसव्यं प्रचक्रमुः <ls>Rām. 6. 107. 21</ls>. .²2 Ruling a country. --{%m.%} .²1 A particular kind of snake. .²2 A snake in general. .²3 A cat. .²4 The pole-cat. .²5 A dog. .²6 The sun. .²7 The fig-tree. .²8 The ruler of a province.
